name: Emerging and unscheduled substances
description: Kratom, tianeptine, xylazine, nitazenes, and PCP: what they are, why they are dangerous, overdose response, and changing 2026 legal status.
intro: New and re-emerging substances are reshaping the drug supply. Some are sold openly in gas stations and online; others are hidden in fentanyl and counterfeit pills. Their legal status is changing fast.

blocks.p: In 2026 the DEA proposed Schedule I for tianeptine, began scheduling concentrated 7-OH kratom products, and continued emergency scheduling of nitazenes, while Congress moved to place xylazine in Schedule III.

blocks.warn: Fentanyl test strips do not detect nitazenes or xylazine. Separate strips exist. Always give naloxone for a suspected opioid overdose, even if xylazine may be involved.
